question: Otto-kun was able to use Al Dona and such after receiving mana from the forest, but could a normal person fire off massive spells like that just from being given mana? Or did the mysterious power of the forest teach him how to use it, or did something related to his Blessing of the Soul of Language allow him to understand how to do it?
answer: It’s not so much that he received mana, as he was allowed to use the mana that had been allowed to build up. In short, the power of a spell changes based on the amount of mana you can use, so with sufficient mana, even Subaru could use Ul Shamac. He could have (past tense).
